page.overview:
What is Cronus?

Cronus, was a greater titan and deity of sinister ambition who was the progenitor of the first generation of Olympian gods. His progeny went on to usurp him, banishing Cronus and his siblings to the depths of Carceri, the plane of imprisonment.

The exact extent of Cronus's deific power following his imprisonment was uncertain. Some claimed that he was a greater power, and others considered him to be some sort of near-deity, similar to the Lady of Pain.

Cronus had a handsome visage, with dark gleaming eyes, and stood over a tall.

Anger simmered beneath the surface for Cronus over his eons of imprisonment, liable to boil up at any moment and cause him to unexpectedly lash out at people. He was also quite paranoid.
